name: What is the difference between home staging and interior design?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between home staging and interior design?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both home staging and interior design involve aesthetics, their objectives differ significantly. Interior design focuses on personalizing a space to suit the homeowner's tastes and long-term living. Home staging, conversely, is about depersonalizing and neutralizing a property to appeal to the widest possible range of potential buyers, emphasizing aspirational living. Kelby Contreras focuses on strategic enhancements that highlight your home's architectural merits and maximize its market appeal, rather than creating a personal living space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Home staging prepares a property for sale by appealing to many buyers, while interior design customizes a space for personal living. Staging aims to maximize market appeal.
